name: Comino in a day
description_md:
Comino in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The day is anchored in Comino in MT.

The route features six sightseeing stops along the way. The total distance is 12.8 km of walking between stops. The full day takes about 7.6 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
